note: Election of the county council, 1946, the first after the wartime postponement of the 1942 and 1945 elections: nominations received by W. Jenkinson, returning officer, 19 September 1946; contests in Armagh and Lurgan, polled 3 October 1946. The Belfast News-Letter prints no party labels, so none are given for the unopposed members. Hawthorne, Richardson, McCreesh and Mrs. Greeves were new members. Polled 3 October 1946. Printed "Armagh Urban" and "Armagh City". Agnew had been Labour M.P. for South Armagh. About 3,400 on the register, a poll of about 82 per cent.
